title: Router triage popover labels are swapped: the 'stream' button prioritizes the email class and 'email' prioritizes streaming
detail: Button 'stream' (i=1) submits triage=0 = class index 0, which packet_types.json defines as email; 'email' submits 1 = streaming. The dial promotes the opposite class of its label.
recommended_fix: Map buttons through class_index: labels[1] should submit class_index(cat,"streaming") and labels[2] class_index(cat,"email"), or reorder labels to match indices.

title: Clicking empty ground never closes an open popover: the dismiss path only runs when the press landed on a node
detail: drag.active is set only when the press snaps a node; a press on empty ground leaves it false, so the release branch never calls handle_click_select and the popover stays open until ESC or another node/pipe click.
recommended_fix: In the LEFT-release path, run the click-select/dismiss logic when drag.active is false too (press on empty ground), or close sel on any press that popover_click returns false for.

title: fmt_bprintf/write_uint write past fixed stack buffers with no length guard; draw_forecast's [32] buffer needs 27 literal chars before the digits
detail: Neither fmt_bprintf nor write_uint checks the destination length; write_uint emits up to 20 digits plus sign. '~%ds out - build capacity NOW' is 27 chars, so a horizon of 6+ digits or any negative secs overflows the [32] stack buffer. Shipped data (start_tick 1200) fits today.
recommended_fix: Have fmt_bprintf/write_int/write_uint bound writes against len(buf) and truncate (or skip); keep buffers sized for worst-case i32 digits.

title: map_draw grid loops spin forever when tile == 0: the minimized-window state (scale == 0) is guarded in from_screen but not in the draw path
evidence:
app/render/map.odin:
	tile := v.tile_px * v.scale
	x := v.off_x
	for x < f32(v.win_w) {
		rl.DrawLine(i32(x), 0, i32(x), v.win_h, grid_soft)
		x += tile
	}
app/render/view.odin:
	if v.scale <= 0 { return 0, 0 } // minimized window guard
detail: With a zero window dimension, view_compute sets scale=0, so tile=0 and the grid loop's x never advances; off_x=win_w/2 < win_w enters the loop. draw_frame calls draw_world unconditionally, so the app hangs where from_screen already guards the same state.
recommended_fix: Skip map_draw/draw_world (or the grid pass) when v.scale <= 0, mirroring the from_screen minimized-window guard.

title: action_log backing is heap-allocated by bus_submit/testkit and never freed: run_context_destroy leaks it on every restart
evidence:
app/run/run.odin bus_submit:
	logged := cmd
	logged.apply_tick = apply_tick
	append(&rc.state.action_log, logged)
app/run/run.odin run_context_destroy:
	delete(rc.snapshot.nodes)
	delete(rc.snapshot.pipes)
	delete(rc.snapshot.packets)
	delete(rc.snapshot.classes)
	delete(rc.snapshot.forecasts)
	delete(rc.autopilot_wired)
	delete(rc.arena_buf)
	rc.state = nil
detail: bus_submit appends with the caller's default heap allocator while the run arena (arena_buf) is deleted; no delete of action_log exists anywhere, so each R restart/start_run leaks the log's heap backing. Small per run but unbounded across a session.
recommended_fix: delete(rc.state.action_log) in run_context_destroy (and delete events), or append with the run arena allocator so arena teardown reclaims it.

title: tier_by_name drops tier_index's ok: an unknown/missing tier silently maps the 1/2/3 keys to tier 0 instead of rejecting
detail: Catalog load cross-validates node types (content_host/residential/router_mid) and classes (email/streaming) but not pipe-tier ids; a dev-edited pipe_tiers.json missing 'narrow'/'standard'/'wide' makes keys 1/2/3 silently select the first tier with no hint.
recommended_fix: In tier_by_name, return (0, false) when tier_index fails and ignore the keypress (or hint), and add narrow/standard/wide to catalogs_load required-content checks.
